questionText:
Which one of the following sentence sequences creates a coherent narrative?

(i) Once on the terrace, on her way to her small room in the corner, she notices the man right away.
(ii) She begins to pant by the time she has climbed all the stairs.
(iii) Mina has bought vegetables and rice at the market, so her bags are heavy.
(iv) He was leaning against the parapet, watching the traffic below.
explanation:
To form a logical and coherent narrative:

1. Sentence (iii) introduces the main character (Mina) and sets up the context (her heavy bags from the market).
2. Sentence (ii) logically follows, explaining that she pants while climbing the stairs due to the heavy bags.
3. Sentence (i) describes her arrival at the top (terrace) where she notices a man.
4. Sentence (iv) describes 'the man' introduced in sentence (i).

Thus, the correct sequence is (iii), (ii), (i), (iv).
